name: code-server
summary: HTTP 8080 checked with /healthz, with the editor's WebSockets kept open.
notes: The editor and its terminals run over WebSockets that last as long as the tab is open. /healthz answers without signing in; the status it reports, alive or expired, says whether anyone has been active and not whether the server is well, so only the status code is checked. code-server listens on 127.0.0.1 until bind-addr says otherwise.
